notes.title: 2021.10.26 important update
notes.notes:
Content of this update:
Major updates:
1. Reset the plot and content of the forest (night) scene, making it more reasonable in plot logic and trigger.
2. A new Panshan road scene is added to the transition from forest to mountain top, which makes up for the plot gap between forest and mountain top.

Detail update:
1. The difficulty of checkpoints between valley scenes and swamp (night) scenes is still high. The location of clearance props in the scene is adjusted to reduce the difficulty of finding clearance props.
2. Update a new action in other scenes - back. In some situations that show fear and fear, the protagonist, the loving mother dragon, will show the back action.
3. A new sound effect is added to the scene in the mountains - the mountain wind blows.
